rows.note: For creative works such as speeches, literature, or music, 創作 is the all-purpose verb.

example.english: I love to compose Cantonese songs.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 cong3 zok3 gwong2 dung1 go1

rows.note: Use this pattern to state what parts or members make up a whole.

example.traditional: 呢隊樂隊由五個人組成。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 ngok6 deoi6 jau4 ng5 go3 jan4 zou2 sing4

rows.note: Use 組合 when actively putting separate parts together to make something.

example.english: I compose a table by joining several wooden boards.
example.traditional: 我將幾塊木板組合成一張枱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 gei2 faai3 muk6 baan2 zou2 hap6 sing4 jat1 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use this when telling someone to calm down or regain composure.

example.english: Compose yourself first, and don't get so worked up.
example.traditional: 你冷靜落嚟先，唔好咁激動。
example.jyutping: nei5 laang5 zing6 lok6 lai4 sin1 m4 hou2 gam3 gik1 dung6
